easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
description:
Cast Warhost's Frenzy with kicker by paying {2}{B}{R}.
Draw a card.
Lyla triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
When the Servo dies, Warhost's Frenzy triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 3.
